text: だいの　もじの　ほのおで　あいてを　こうげきする。
note: Flames in the shape of the character 大 ("big") recall Kyoto's Gozan no Okuribi festival, where a giant 大 is lit in bonfires on a mountainside every August 16. The English line drops the character shape and just describes an intense flame.
claim: At Kyoto's Gozan no Okuribi festival on August 16, bonfires in the shape of the character 大 are lit on a mountainside.

check.quote: It is the culmination of the Obon festival on August 16, in which five giant bonfires are lit on mountains surrounding the city. ... Daimonji (大文字), the character meaning 'large' or 'great', is lit on Daimonji-Yama/Higashi-Yama, Nyoigatake at 8 pm
